categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved directly through payment without enforcement steps, advancing 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', judged against indicator 'Time to fine dispatch (days)' and 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 12 as supported by frequent variants such as V0002 and V0007.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved via payment after enforcement actions (penalties or notifications) have been applied, supporting 'Maximize timely fine revenue', judged against 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 13 as evidenced by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payment occurs after penalties/notifications.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving administrative appeals submitted to the Prefecture, preserving offender's due-process rights while potentially impacting enforcement costs and revenue, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 14, evidenced by workflow sequences containing date entry, sending, and results from the Prefecture (e.g., V0008, V0057).

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases involving judicial appeals escalated to a Judge, maximizing due process rights while hurting cost and revenue metrics, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Judge (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 19, supported by variants explicitly showing 'Appeal to Judge' activities (e.g., V0103, V0176).

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Unresolved cases pushed to coercive credit collection, helping fine revenue but hurting enforcement costs, judged against 'Average time to case closure (days)'.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative 20, evidenced by variants terminating with credit collection activities (e.g., V0001, V0009).
